piero-della-francesca.role: Painter and Mathematician of Borgo Sansepolcro

theaetetus.role: Greek Geometer of the Platonic Academy

thomas-aquinas.bio: Scholastic authority on Aristotelian natural philosophy and epistemology.
works: In Libros Physicorum et De Caelo

tommaso-soderini.bio: Nephew of Piero Soderini mentioned in Pacioli's 1509 dedicatory epistle.

vegetius.name: Vegetius Renatus, Publius Flavius
vegetius.bio: Author of Epitoma Rei Militaris, cited in Compendio Chapter II on the mathematical foundations of Roman military engineering.
